script.title: The Last Ember — a dragon and its golden egg
script.description: A crimson guardian spreads great scalloped, black-boned wings over its golden egg. Swept ivory horns, watchful golden eyes, open jaws, a plated throat, four muscular clawed legs and a curling armoured tail create a dramatic freestanding dragon.
